views.name: cards_with_cardkingdom_ids
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  cards.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId
FROM cards
views.description: All card rows with their Card Kingdom foil and non-foil IDs and basic identifiers. Useful as a cohort for queries that need to check presence/absence or compare foil vs non-foil Card Kingdom data.

views.name: cards_basic_identity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.mcmId AS mcmId,
  cards.scryfallId AS scryfallId,
  cards.multiverseId AS multiverseId
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical identity and basic metadata for each card. Normalizes frequently-used identity columns and exposes set code for joins to set-level data.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_and_legal_overview
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.setCode,
  c.cardKingdomFoilId,
  c.cardKingdomId,
  COALESCE(fd.foreign_count, 0) AS foreign_count,
  COALESCE(lg.legalities_count, 0) AS legalities_count
FROM cards_with_cardkingdom_ids c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(*) AS foreign_count
  FROM foreign_data
  GROUP BY uuid
) fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(*) AS legalities_count
  FROM legalities
  GROUP BY uuid
) lg ON lg.uuid = c.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view combining core card identity with counts of foreign-language entries and counts of legalities per card. Useful for queries that need card-level metadata plus related counts from foreign_data and legalities.

views.name: cards_core_attributes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  NULLIF(c.borderColor, '') AS borderColor,
  NULLIF(c.cardKingdomFoilId, '') AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  NULLIF(c.cardKingdomId, '') AS cardKingdomId,
  NULLIF(c.availability, '') AS availability,
  c.setCode,
  c.type,
  c.rarity
FROM cards AS c
grain: one row per cards.id (one row per card record)

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filtering; returns all rows from cards with normalized empty->NULL

views.description: Normalized core card attributes and canonicalized product fields useful for filtering availability and print/border properties. Cleans empty-string vs NULL for key product id and availability fields.

views.name: cards_cardkingdom_availability_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  CASE
    WHEN trim(COALESCE(c.cardKingdomId, '')) = '' THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS cardKingdomHasNonFoil,
  CASE
    WHEN trim(COALESCE(c.cardKingdomFoilId, '')) = '' THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS cardKingdomHasFoil,
  -- canonical availability: prefer cards.availability if non-empty, else derive from ids
  CASE
    WHEN trim(COALESCE(c.availability, '')) <> '' THEN c.availability
    WHEN trim(COALESCE(c.cardKingdomId, '')) = '' AND trim(COALESCE(c.cardKingdomFoilId, '')) = '' THEN ''
    WHEN trim(COALESCE(c.cardKingdomId, '')) <> '' AND trim(COALESCE(c.cardKingdomFoilId, '')) <> '' THEN 'cardkingdom,cardkingdom_foil'
    WHEN trim(COALESCE(c.cardKingdomId, '')) <> '' THEN 'cardkingdom'
    WHEN trim(COALESCE(c.cardKingdomFoilId, '')) <> '' THEN 'cardkingdom_foil'
    ELSE ''
  END AS availability_canonical
FROM cards_core_attributes c

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filtering; only computes flags from cardKingdomId and cardKingdomFoilId

views.description: Cohort of cards annotated with boolean flags indicating presence of Card Kingdom non-foil and foil product ids and a canonical availability string. Useful to answer questions about whether specific storefront product variants exist.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_and_legality_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  COALESCE(fd.foreign_count, 0) AS foreign_count,
  COALESCE(l.legality_count, 0) AS legality_count
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(*) AS foreign_count
  FROM foreign_data
  GROUP BY uuid
) fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(*) AS legality_count
  FROM legalities
  GROUP BY uuid
) l ON l.uuid = c.uuid

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filtering; aggregates over foreign_data and legalities

views.description: Denormalized card-level view that attaches counts of foreign language entries and legalities for each card UUID. Useful for filtering/sorting by how many translations or legal formats a card has.

views.name: cards_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  trim(cards.name) AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  trim(cards.number) AS number,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards
grain: cards.id  -- one row per card printing (primary key)
views.description: Normalized projection of the primary cards table exposing stable identifiers and common card attributes used for filtering, grouping and display (one row per card printing). Does light canonicalization: trims key text fields and preserves raw values for numeric measures.

views.name: card_legalities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS id,
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM legalities
grain: legalities.id  -- one row per legality record (per card uuid + format)
views.description: Row-level cohort of legalities for cards. Exposes the canonical relation between a card (uuid) and its format/status entries so queries can filter by format or status (one row per legality entry).
validated_on: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.

views.name: cards_with_legality
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.number AS number,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  legalities.id AS format_id,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  legalities.id AS legality_id
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: one row per cards.id x legalities.id (card printing joined to a single legality entry)
views.description: Denormalized join of card printings with their legality records. One row per (card printing, legality) pair; useful to answer questions about cards having specific legal statuses in formats and for easy projection of card display fields together with legality fields.

views.name: cards_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.side AS side,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized card-level rows exposing primary identifiers and canonical card attributes useful for filtering and joins (one row per card row in cards table). Does not apply question-specific filters.
validated_on: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.

views.name: card_legalities_10
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  legalities.id AS id
FROM legalities
views.description: Denormalized legalities per card uuid. One row per card-legal-format combining cards.uuid and legality rows to make format-level queries easy.

views.name: cards_with_legality_11
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS id,
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.type AS type,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM legalities
JOIN cards ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
views.description: Joined view of card attributes with their legalities. Each row is a card x format legality. Suitable for filtering by card attributes and formats without rejoining base tables.

views.name: cards_core_12
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.artist AS artist,
  cards.power AS power,
  cards.toughness AS toughness,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized/card-level canonical projection exposing card identifiers, names, core attributes (artist, power, toughness, mana cost, types) and canonical uuid to join other card-scoped tables. Use this as the base card entity for filtering and joins.

views.name: card_legalities_by_format
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  card_legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  card_legalities.format AS format,
  card_legalities.status AS status
FROM card_legalities
grain: (uuid, format) one row per card uuid and rules format
views.description: Card-format legality rows: one row per card uuid and format, exposing legality status so callers can filter for formats (e.g., commander) and statuses (e.g., Legal/Banned).

views.name: card_with_legality
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.artist AS artist,
  cards.power AS power,
  cards.type AS type,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: cards.id x legalities.format (one row per card row and format)
views.description: Denormalized join of cards with their legalities (one row per cards.id and legalities.format), combining core card attributes with format-specific legality to simplify queries that need card attributes together with legality for a given format.

views.name: cards_core_15
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  NULLIF(trim(c.uuid), '') AS uuid,
  NULLIF(trim(c.name), '') AS name,
  NULLIF(trim(c.artist), '') AS artist,
  CASE
    WHEN c.hasContentWarning IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 0
    WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 1
    ELSE NULL
  END AS hasContentWarning,
  NULLIF(trim(c.manaCost), '') AS manaCost,
  NULLIF(trim(c.type), '') AS type,
  NULLIF(trim(c.text), '') AS text,
  NULLIF(trim(c.flavorText), '') AS flavorText,
  NULLIF(trim(c.originalText), '') AS originalText,
  NULLIF(trim(c.power), '') AS power,
  NULLIF(trim(c.toughness), '') AS toughness,
  NULLIF(trim(c.rarity), '') AS rarity,
  NULLIF(trim(c.setCode), '') AS setCode
FROM cards c
grain: one row per cards.id (one row per physical card record)
views.description: Canonical, cleaned projection of the cards table exposing stable identifiers, key descriptive fields, flags, and textual fields. Normalizes empty-string/placeholder values to NULL for easier missing-value detection.

views.name: cards_missing_property_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  json_group_array(prop) AS missing_or_degraded_properties
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT id AS cid, 'artist' AS prop FROM cards WHERE artist IS NULL OR trim(artist) = '' OR lower(trim(artist)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'asciiName' AS prop FROM cards WHERE asciiName IS NULL OR trim(asciiName) = '' OR lower(trim(asciiName)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'availability' AS prop FROM cards WHERE availability IS NULL OR trim(availability) = '' OR lower(trim(availability)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'borderColor' AS prop FROM cards WHERE borderColor IS NULL OR trim(borderColor) = '' OR lower(trim(borderColor)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'cardKingdomId' AS prop FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomId IS NULL OR trim(cardKingdomId) = '' OR lower(trim(cardKingdomId)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'colorIdentity' AS prop FROM cards WHERE colorIdentity IS NULL OR trim(colorIdentity) = '' OR lower(trim(colorIdentity)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'colors' AS prop FROM cards WHERE colors IS NULL OR trim(colors) = '' OR lower(trim(colors)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'convertedManaCost' AS prop FROM cards WHERE convertedManaCost IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'edhrecRank' AS prop FROM cards WHERE edhrecRank IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'flavorText' AS prop FROM cards WHERE flavorText IS NULL OR trim(flavorText) = '' OR lower(trim(flavorText)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'frameVersion' AS prop FROM cards WHERE frameVersion IS NULL OR trim(frameVersion) = '' OR lower(trim(frameVersion)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'hasFoil' AS prop FROM cards WHERE hasFoil IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'hasNonFoil' AS prop FROM cards WHERE hasNonFoil IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'isReprint' AS prop FROM cards WHERE isReprint IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'keywords' AS prop FROM cards WHERE keywords IS NULL OR trim(keywords) = '' OR lower(trim(keywords)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'layout' AS prop FROM cards WHERE layout IS NULL OR trim(layout) = '' OR lower(trim(layout)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'manaCost' AS prop FROM cards WHERE manaCost IS NULL OR trim(manaCost) = '' OR lower(trim(manaCost)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'mcmId' AS prop FROM cards WHERE mcmId IS NULL OR trim(mcmId) = '' OR lower(trim(mcmId)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'mtgjsonV4Id' AS prop FROM cards WHERE mtgjsonV4Id IS NULL OR trim(mtgjsonV4Id) = '' OR lower(trim(mtgjsonV4Id)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'multiverseId' AS prop FROM cards WHERE multiverseId IS NULL OR trim(multiverseId) = '' OR lower(trim(multiverseId)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'name' AS prop FROM cards WHERE name IS NULL OR trim(name) = '' OR lower(trim(name)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'number' AS prop FROM cards WHERE number IS NULL OR trim(number) = '' OR lower(trim(number)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'originalText' AS prop FROM cards WHERE originalText IS NULL OR trim(originalText) = '' OR lower(trim(originalText)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'power' AS prop FROM cards WHERE power IS NULL OR trim(power) = '' OR lower(trim(power)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'printings' AS prop FROM cards WHERE printings IS NULL OR trim(printings) = '' OR lower(trim(printings)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'purchaseUrls' AS prop FROM cards WHERE purchaseUrls IS NULL OR trim(purchaseUrls) = '' OR lower(trim(purchaseUrls)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'rarity' AS prop FROM cards WHERE rarity IS NULL OR trim(rarity) = '' OR lower(trim(rarity)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'scryfallId' AS prop FROM cards WHERE scryfallId IS NULL OR trim(scryfallId) = '' OR lower(trim(scryfallId)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'setCode' AS prop FROM cards WHERE setCode IS NULL OR trim(setCode) = '' OR lower(trim(setCode)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'subtypes' AS prop FROM cards WHERE subtypes IS NULL OR trim(subtypes) = '' OR lower(trim(subtypes)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'text' AS prop FROM cards WHERE text IS NULL OR trim(text) = '' OR lower(trim(text)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'toughness' AS prop FROM cards WHERE toughness IS NULL OR trim(toughness) = '' OR lower(trim(toughness)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'type' AS prop FROM cards WHERE type IS NULL OR trim(type) = '' OR lower(trim(type)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'types' AS prop FROM cards WHERE types IS NULL OR trim(types) = '' OR lower(trim(types)) = 'unknown'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id AS cid, 'uuid' AS prop FROM cards WHERE uuid IS NULL OR trim(uuid) = '' OR lower(trim(uuid)) = 'unknown'
) problems ON problems.cid = cards.id
GROUP BY cards.id, cards.uuid
views.description: Row-level derivation listing which card properties are missing or degraded. For each card uuid (or id) returns an array/list of column names whose values are NULL, empty, or equal to common placeholder strings like 'unknown'. Useful to quickly determine data-completeness issues per card.

views.name: card_rulings_by_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  rulings.id AS "rulings.id",
  rulings.date AS "rulings.date",
  rulings.text AS "rulings.text"
FROM rulings
JOIN cards ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: one row per ruling (linked to a card via uuid). Cards with no rulings are not present as rows in this view; callers should LEFT JOIN to include empty arrays where needed.
views.description: Denormalized view of rulings joined to their card (by uuid). Exposes one row per ruling with card reference, allowing aggregation into arrays of ruling objects per card in higher-level queries.

views.name: cards_base_18
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  NULLIF(cards.uuid, '') AS uuid,
  NULLIF(cards.name, '') AS name,
  NULLIF(cards.artist, '') AS artist,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.isPromo IS NULL THEN 0
    ELSE cards.isPromo
  END AS isPromo,
  NULLIF(cards.setCode, '') AS setCode,
  NULLIF(sets.releaseDate, '') AS releaseDate,
  NULLIF(cards.type, '') AS type,
  NULLIF(cards.rarity, '') AS rarity
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
views.description: Canonical projection of the cards table with primary identifiers and commonly used attributes (name, artist, uuid, isPromo) normalized and NULL-canonicalized for joins and downstream queries.

views.name: rulings_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.id AS id,
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  rulings.date AS date,
  rulings.text AS text
FROM rulings
views.description: Row-level rulings entries with their associated card UUID and ruling date/text. Use as the canonical cohort of rulings prior to aggregation or joining to cards.
validated_on: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.

views.name: card_rulings_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  COUNT(rulings.id) AS rulings_count
FROM rulings
GROUP BY rulings.uuid
views.description: Aggregated measure of number of rulings per card uuid. Exposes uuid and rulings_count so callers can join to card metadata and apply ordering/limits.

views.name: foreign_data_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  language,
  name,
  text,
  flavorText,
  type,
  multiverseid
FROM foreign_data
views.description: Row-level view exposing each foreign_data record and its core descriptive columns. Useful as the base cohort for counts, language filters, and joins back to cards by uuid.

views.name: foreign_data_language_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  language AS language,
  COUNT(id) AS language_count
FROM
  foreign_data
GROUP BY
  language
views.description: Aggregated counts per language for foreign_data. Returns one row per language with the raw count; useful for percentage calculations and ranking languages by prevalence.

views.name: cards_core_attributes_23
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  NULLIF(cards.uuid, '') AS uuid,
  NULLIF(cards.name, '') AS name,
  NULLIF(cards.setCode, '') AS setCode,
  NULLIF(cards.number, '') AS number,
  NULLIF(cards.power, '') AS power,
  NULLIF(cards.toughness, '') AS toughness,
  NULLIF(cards.manaCost, '') AS manaCost,
  NULLIF(cards.types, '') AS types,
  NULLIF(cards.subtypes, '') AS subtypes,
  NULLIF(cards.rarity, '') AS rarity,
  NULLIF(sets.releaseDate, '') AS releaseDate
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
grain: one row per cards.id (each card printing/row)
views.description: Normalized core attributes of each card useful for filtering and aggregation (one row per card version/printing). Converts empty strings to NULL and preserves identifying keys and key text/numeric attributes like power, toughness, mana cost, types, rarity, set, and names.

views.name: cards_text_and_foreign_variants
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name AS foreign_name",
  foreign_data.text AS "foreign_data.text AS foreign_text",
  rulings.date AS "rulings.date AS ruling_date",
  rulings.text AS "rulings.text AS ruling_text",
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id",
  rulings.id AS "rulings.id"
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
LEFT JOIN rulings ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
WHERE 1=1
grain: one row per (cards.id, foreign_data.id, rulings.id) combination when present
views.description: Denormalized view joining cards with available foreign-language variants and rulings; exposes card uuid and language-specific name/text and rulings so queries can filter by exact text matches or language-specific power/name variants.

views.name: cards_legality_and_set_context
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  sets.code AS "sets.code AS setCode",
  sets.name AS "sets.name AS set_name",
  sets.releaseDate AS "sets.releaseDate",
  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status",
  legalities.id AS legalities_id,
  sets.id AS sets_id
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
LEFT JOIN sets ON sets.code = cards.setCode
grain: one row per (cards.id, legalities.id) to represent each legality entry
views.description: Card-level view that brings in legality statuses across formats and the set metadata (code, name, release date). Useful for filtering cards by format legality, set release window, or grouping by set.

views.name: cards_base_26
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.text AS text,
  cards.originalReleaseDate AS originalReleaseDate
FROM cards
views.description: One-row-per-card core card attributes (basic identifying and display fields) for filtering and projection. Useful as the primary cohort for most card-level questions.

views.name: cards_by_uuid_with_legalities_and_rulings
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS card_id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.borderColor AS borderColor,
  l.format AS format,
  l.status AS legality_status,
  r.date AS ruling_date,
  r.text AS ruling_text
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
LEFT JOIN rulings r
  ON r.uuid = c.uuid
views.description: Denormalized card-level view joining the core card row to its related legalities and rulings text entries (one row per card x related row). Useful for questions needing legality status or official rulings alongside card attributes.

views.name: cards_foreign_names
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS card_id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  foreign_data.name AS foreign_name,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.text AS foreign_text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS foreign_flavorText,
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Card-level mapping to available foreign/localized name, text, flavorText and language. One row per card x foreign-language variant. Useful for localization or multilingual lookups and to check alternate printed names.

views.name: cards_core_29
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.originalType AS originalType,
  cards.text AS text,
  cards.originalText AS originalText,
  cards.flavorText AS flavorText,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity
FROM cards
grain: cards.uuid  -- one row per card row (printing) identified by uuid
views.description: Normalized core card attributes and text fields for each unique card printing (one row per cards.uuid). Exposes identifying keys, display fields, mana/type/text fields and common metadata used by queries and joins.

views.name: card_rulings
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  rulings.id AS ruling_id,
  rulings.date AS date,
  rulings.text AS text
FROM rulings
grain: rulings.id  -- one row per ruling record
views.description: Rulings per card uuid. One row per ruling entry with ruling text and ruling date; intended to be joined to cards by uuid and ordered by date for presentation.

views.name: card_with_rulings_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.text AS text,
  cards.originalText AS originalText,
  cards.originalType AS originalType,
  rulings.id AS ruling_id,
  rulings.date AS ruling_date,
  rulings.text AS ruling_text
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN rulings ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: one row per cards.uuid and rulings.id combination (left join preserves cards without rulings)
views.description: Denormalized join of core card fields with rulings. Produces one row per (card uuid, ruling) pair; if a card has no rulings, the card row should still be selectable via LEFT JOIN semantics (ruling columns NULL). Useful for queries that need card text plus any number of rulings ordered by date.

views.name: cards_basic

Keeps raw values (no aggregations) so downstream queries can compute percentages, counts and groups. Normalization here is limited to selecting and renaming important columns.

views.name: cards_bordercolor_cohort

views.name: sets_basic

validated_on: How many cards with original type of "Summon - Angel" have subtype other than "Angel"?

views.name: cards_normalized_subtypes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS card_id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  TRIM(substr(value, 1)) AS subtype_token
FROM
  cards AS c,
  json_each(
    -- turn comma-separated subtypes into a JSON array by replacing commas with "," and wrapping
    -- but first escape any existing double quotes
    json_replace(
      json_quote('[' || replace(replace(subtypes, '"', '\"'), ',', '","') || ']'),
      '$', json_extract(json_quote(subtypes), '$') /* no-op to keep valid JSON usage */
    )
  ) 
WHERE
  subtypes IS NOT NULL
views.description: Normalized projection that splits and canonicalizes the comma-separated subtypes field into one row per (card_id, subtype_token). Trims whitespace and preserves original card id and uuid for joins.

views.name: cards_core_attributes_40
views.body_sql:

views.name: cards_with_set_info

views.name: card_foreign_and_legal_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  GROUP_CONCAT(c.id) AS id_list,
  MAX(c.name) AS card_name_example,
  COALESCE(fd_count.foreign_count, 0) AS foreign_count,
  COALESCE(lg_count.legality_count, 0) AS legality_count
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS foreign_count
  FROM foreign_data
  WHERE uuid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY uuid
) fd_count ON fd_count.uuid = c.uuid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS legality_count
  FROM legalities
  WHERE uuid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY uuid
) lg_count ON lg_count.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
views.description: Card-level summarization that indicates presence and counts of related foreign language entries and legality entries per card (one row per cards.uuid). Useful for filtering or ranking cards by localization coverage or number of legalities.

views.name: cards_core_43
views.body_sql:
SELECT

views.name: card_legalities_44

views.name: cards_with_legal_status_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS card_id,

  c.borderColor AS borderColor,
  MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Banned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_banned,
  MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Restricted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_restricted,
  MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Legal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_legal,
  COUNT(l.id) AS num_legal_entries
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.id, c.name, c.borderColor
views.description: Card-level aggregated flags summarizing existence of legal status values per card (one row per card uuid). Exposes boolean-like flags such as has_banned, has_restricted, has_legal which are useful for filtering and counts without re-scanning legalities details.

views.name: cards_core_46

views.name: card_foreign_translations

views.name: cards_by_type_and_color
views.body_sql:

views.name: cards_row_level

FROM cards
views.description: Row-level canonical view of the cards table exposing identity, key descriptive fields, and common filterable attributes (one row per card record).

views.name: cards_canonical_strings
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.name), '') AS name,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.manaCost), '') AS manaCost,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.layout), '') AS layout,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.frameVersion), '') AS frameVersion,
  CASE
    WHEN trim(cards.borderColor) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE lower(trim(cards.borderColor))
  END AS borderColor,
  CASE
    WHEN trim(cards.availability) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE lower(trim(cards.availability))
  END AS availability,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.colors IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN trim(cards.colors) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE lower(replace(replace(trim(cards.colors), ' ', ''), ';', ',')) -- normalize spacing and separators
  END AS colors_canonical,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.colorIdentity IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN trim(cards.colorIdentity) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE upper(replace(replace(trim(cards.colorIdentity), ' ', ''), ',', '')) -- canonical as compact uppercase (e.g. WUBRG)
  END AS colorIdentity_canonical,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.type IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN trim(cards.type) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE replace(trim(cards.type), '—', '-') -- normalize dash style but keep casing
  END AS type_canonical,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.subtypes IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN trim(cards.subtypes) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE lower(replace(replace(trim(cards.subtypes), ' ', ''), ',', ',')) -- lowercase and remove internal spaces
  END AS subtypes_canonical,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.rarity IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN trim(cards.rarity) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE lower(trim(cards.rarity))
  END AS rarity_canonical
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized textual/categorical fields from cards: trims and canonicalizes common nullable text fields and makes simple canonical replacements (NULL when empty). Useful for consistent filtering and presentation.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_by_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT

views.name: cards_core_attributes_60
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  trim(nullif(c.name, '')) AS name,
  -- prefer cleaned text fields: use text if present, else originalText, else flavorText
  trim(
    coalesce(
      nullif(c.text, ''),
      nullif(c.originalText, ''),
      nullif(c.flavorText, '')
    )
  ) AS text,
  -- normalize numeric-like power/toughness to NULL when empty string
  NULLIF(trim(c.power), '') AS power,
  NULLIF(trim(c.toughness), '') AS toughness,
  NULLIF(trim(c.manaCost), '') AS manaCost,
  NULLIF(trim(c.type), '') AS type,
  NULLIF(trim(c.colors), '') AS colors,
  NULLIF(trim(c.colorIdentity), '') AS colorIdentity,
  NULLIF(trim(c.rarity), '') AS rarity,
  NULLIF(trim(c.setCode), '') AS setCode
FROM cards c
views.description: Canonical per-card attributes with cleaned textual fields and canonical nulls for numeric/text measures commonly used in filters (power/toughness/manaCost/text/name/uuid).

views.name: cards_text_index
views.body_sql:

views.name: cards_power_unknown_cohort

views.name: cards_core_attributes_63

views.name: sets_with_translations_68

views.name: card_basic_attributes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  -- normalize releaseDate from cards.originalReleaseDate where available; keep NULL if absent
  cards.originalReleaseDate AS releaseDate,
  -- boolean flags normalized to 0/1 integers
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(cards.hasContentWarning, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasContentWarning,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(cards.isReprint, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isReprint,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(cards.isPromo, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isPromo,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(cards.isOnlineOnly, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isOnlineOnly,
  -- pass-through metadata
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  -- canonical color fields (keep as stored text; NULL if empty)
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.colors), '') AS colors,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.colorIdentity), '') AS colorIdentity,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.manaCost), '') AS manaCost,
  -- ensure numeric converted mana cost
  CASE
    WHEN cards.convertedManaCost IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE cards.convertedManaCost
  END AS convertedManaCost,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.type), '') AS type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.types), '') AS types,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.subtypes), '') AS subtypes
FROM cards
views.description: One row per card (print/version) exposing stable identifiers and normalized boolean/metadata attributes useful for filtering and aggregation (e.g., content warning, legality joins, release/set linkage). Casts/normalizes obvious typed fields.

views.name: card_legalities_70

views.name: card_foreign_names_texts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  f.uuid AS uuid,
  f.language AS language,
  f.name AS foreign_name,
  f.type AS foreign_type,
  f.text AS foreign_text,
  f.flavorText AS foreign_flavorText,
  f.multiverseid AS multiverseid,
  f.id AS id
FROM foreign_data f
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = f.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view linking card UUIDs to available foreign-language names, types, and texts. Useful for cross-language lookups and for filtering cards that have localized text present.

views.name: cards_without_power_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  uuid,
  id,
  name,
  setCode,
  power
FROM cards
WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*'
views.description: One row per card (card uuid) for cards that lack a power value (either power IS NULL or power equals the wildcard '*' ). Exposes card identifiers and minimal identifying attributes useful for joins and grouping.

views.name: card_foreign_localizations_73
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.uuid AS foreign_uuid,
  cards.uuid AS card_uuid,
  cards.id AS card_id,
  cards.name AS card_name,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS foreign_name,
  foreign_data.text AS foreign_text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS foreign_flavorText,
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid,
  foreign_data.id AS foreign_data_id,
  cards.id AS card_table_id
FROM foreign_data
LEFT JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: one row per foreign_data record (linked to cards.uuid)
views.description: Localization rows for cards: one row per foreign_data entry joined to the parent card uuid and card id/name. Useful to filter or aggregate by language for each card.

views.name: cards_with_localization_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS card_uuid,
  cards.id AS card_id,
  COUNT(foreign_data.id) AS has_any_foreign_data_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN foreign_data.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_french_count
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
GROUP BY cards.uuid, cards.id
views.description: Per-card aggregation indicating which languages have at least one foreign_data entry for that card. Produces boolean-like presence flags or counts per language. Designed for quick membership tests (e.g. has_french).

views.name: foreign_texts_by_multiverseid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS id,
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid,
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS name,
  foreign_data.text AS text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS flavorText,
  foreign_data.type AS type
FROM foreign_data
grain: foreign_data.id  -- one row per foreign_data entry
views.description: One-row-per-foreign-translation entry, filtered/cohortable by multiverseid, language, and uuid. Exposes the textual fields needed for lookups and joins to the cards table.

views.name: card_identity_for_foreign_entries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name AS card_name",
  cards.setCode AS "cards.setCode",
  cards.multiverseId AS "cards.multiverseId",
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS "foreign_data.multiverseid AS foreign_multiverseid",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name AS foreign_name",
  foreign_data.text AS "foreign_data.text AS foreign_text",
  foreign_data.flavorText AS "foreign_data.flavorText AS foreign_flavor_text"
FROM foreign_data
JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: foreign_data.id  -- one row per foreign_data translation (joined to its card)
views.description: Denormalized relation joining cards to their foreign_data translations by uuid, exposing card identity and set metadata together with foreign language fields for queries that need both card and translation attributes.

views.name: sets_basic_77
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  code AS code,
  name AS name,
  releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  type AS type,
  block AS block,
  totalSetSize AS totalSetSize
FROM sets
views.description: Normalized projection of sets with key identifiers and release metadata useful for filtering or joining by set code or release date.

views.name: cards_layout_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.layout AS layout,
  cards.isTextless AS isTextless,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards
views.description: Row-level cohort of cards with layout-related fields and common card identifiers. Useful to filter by layout values (e.g. 'normal') and to compute counts/percentages across layout cohorts.

views.name: cards_text_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.layout AS layout,
  cards.isTextless AS isTextless_raw,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.isTextless IS NULL THEN 0
    WHEN cards.isTextless = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS isTextless_flag
FROM cards
views.description: Canonicalized boolean/text flags for card text-related attributes. Normalizes nullable flag fields into explicit 0/1 and exposes a derived textless_flag for consistent downstream aggregation.

views.name: cards_layout_aggregates_by_layout
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  layout,
  COUNT(*) AS count_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_textless
FROM cards
GROUP BY layout
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of cards per layout and counts of textless cards per layout. Provides raw counts needed to compute percentages per layout without re-scanning full table.

views.name: set_translations_by_set_81
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  setCode,
  language,
  translation
FROM set_translations
views.description: All translation rows for sets (one row per translation), useful to list languages/translations available for a given set code.

views.name: sets_basic_82
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  code,
  mcmName,
  name,
  releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  type
FROM sets
views.description: Canonical set metadata (one row per set code) with key identifying fields used to confirm or filter sets (e.g., code, mcmName, name, releaseDate, type).

views.name: set_translations_with_setinfo
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  set_translations.setCode AS setCode,
  set_translations.language AS language,
  set_translations.translation AS translation,
  sets.code AS sets_code,
  sets.mcmName AS sets_mcmName,
  sets.name AS sets_name,
  sets.releaseDate AS sets_releaseDate,
  set_translations.id AS id
FROM set_translations
LEFT JOIN sets
  ON set_translations.setCode = sets.code
views.description: Denormalized translations joined to their set metadata so callers can filter by set attributes (e.g., mcmName) while returning translation languages and texts.
